completion_decisions: Retain both paper problem roles, continuous coordinates, 2D spacing, 24 wind sectors, Gaussian wake/RSS, two-stage formulation, and four published alpha0 values.
Use cited FLORIS-v2.4 NREL 5 MW CP/CT and legacy-Gauss lineage data.
Reconstruct Case 1 from the paper equations and figures and Case 2 from deterministic figure-informed polygon, wind, and load topology because native arrays are unavailable.

Use a pinned pure-C++ NLopt Kraft SLSQP replacement, bound-aware central 0.5 m differences with one-sided completion at active bounds, 15 starts, 1e-7 relative x tolerance, and 300 solver evaluations per start.
Precompute and interpolate immutable Case-1 and Case-2 wave-load charts, parallelize independent SLSQP starts with a persistent team, and preserve ordered best-start reduction.
Use 25 platform-standard seeds per paper role and pair two half-core formal processes to fill Waffle's 20 CPU cores.

paper.authors: Ti Zilong and Deng Xiao Wei
paper.title: Layout Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Considering Spatially Inhomogeneous Wave Loads

scope.claim_boundary: academic flexible reconstruction of both paper cases and Multistart-SLSQP; not author source, native environmental arrays, SciPy trajectory, or exact numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: 2D spacing, rectangular or polygon boundary, and alpha0 AEP inequality are explicit SLSQP constraints

decision_variables.resolution: continuous x/y coordinates for 16 or 20 NREL 5 MW turbines

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct double-precision coordinate vector; no discrete decoder

initialization.resolution: 15 deterministic feasible pseudo-random starts plus one reference/incumbent start

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: AEP, alpha1, beta, feasibility, physical FES, timings, worker receipt, and hash for 25 seeds per paper role

objective_and_direction.resolution: Stage 1 maximizes raw AEP; Stage 2 minimizes raw total extreme-wave load under alpha0

paper_native_cases.resolution: Case 1 mild slope and Case 2 polygonal complex terrain are both registered

parameters.resolution: 15 starts, four paper alpha0 values, bound-aware 0.5 m finite differences, x tolerance 1e-7, and 300 solver evaluations per start

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: SLSQP convergence or 300 solver evaluations; every complete base or finite-difference layout physics call is one FES

update_order.resolution: independent starts execute concurrently, write fixed slots, and reduce in start-index order; coupled incumbent propagates across relaxed alpha0 stages

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: FLORIS-v2.4-lineage Gaussian/RSS AEP and independently validated precomputed wave-load charts

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: Case 1 uses 24 equal 8 m/s sectors; Case 2 uses a deterministic digitization of the published 24-sector wind rose
